newsitem.title: NORWAY: Storebrand profits hit by non-life losses.
newsitem.headline: Storebrand profits hit by non-life losses.

text.p: Norway's largest insurer Storebrand ASA said on Wednesday major losses in the non-life sector and a 250 million crown provision for reorganisation were responsible for a 28 percent decline in group profits in the first nine months compared with a year ago.
After distribution of profits to life assurance customers and pension insurance, Storebrand booked a group result of 922 million crowns to September 30 against 1.28 billion a year ago.
The company said the bottom line included provisions of 250 million crowns to cover the reorganisation of the group in 1997, which will include shedding around 450 jobs.
